headline: Ledger Narrows as Weathered Expanse Becomes the War's Busiest Front
war_summary: The ledger has shifted since our last edition: the Colonials' count slips from 282 strongpoints to 279, the Wardens' climbs from 151 to 155, and one ruined work has been raised again, leaving two in no-man's-land, both in Godcrofts. Weathered Expanse now carries the war's storm, fifty-nine actions in the day with blows at Wightwalk and Frostmarch falling to the very closing of this bulletin; its flags stand five Colonials to four Wardens. The Dead Lands have stirred anew about The Salt March and Callahan's Boot, where Warden losses run the heavier. Stlican Shelf counted forty-one episodes, Breaker Town and The Pale House still at their struggle, while Linn of Mercy's once-steepest loss-rate cools, though its twenty-four-hour toll, near eighteen thousand, remains the war's heaviest. Callahan's Passage has slackened markedly, its hourly losses fallen from above one hundred and fifty to scarce a dozen. Stonecradle grinds on at Trammel Pool and The Cord. It is day 197; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
